what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: A four-euro test, to find out what the fifteen-euro one really costs
agents.why: The full test is priced somewhere between fifteen and thirty-three euros, and the whole gap is one thing nobody has measured: whether showing the AI forty funds instead of eighteen makes it think for longer. Thinking was half the last bill. A small run measures that as a side effect, proves the run can be trusted before we pay for the big one, and still gives a direction on whether the AI orders better than we do.
